Class GameController

java.lang.Object
control.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Runs a game of Restaurant Rush: owns the game state and the turn sequence.

Each turn follows the order set out in the README: arrivals, the restaurant state, the Happy Hour offer and recovery, the Host, the Waiter, the Chef (always after the Waiter), eating and payment, then waiting and abandonment. After the last turn the result is Victory if every target in GameConfig is met, otherwise Defeat.

This class never prints or reads the console itself. It shows things through ConsoleUI and reads choices through InputReader.

CT2003 Group 3

    • playTurn

      public void playTurn(int turn)
      Runs one full turn in the order set out in the README.

      The Waiter always acts before the Chef. So when the Waiter serves, any dish that is READY was finished on an earlier turn, and a dish the Chef finishes this turn can only be served next turn. This is how the rule from TODO 15 in Order is enforced; no extra field is needed.

      start() is the normal way to play. This method is public so that checks can play one turn at a time.

      Parameters:
      turn - the turn number, from 1 to config.getTurns()
